facts.text: Vaughan's economy includes more than 19,000 businesses employing approximately 227,000 people, and it accounted for more than 35 percent of York Region's employment and economic output in 2023.
Vaughan's information and communications technology sector employs more than 6,400 workers across more than 1,200 companies.
More than 1,300 businesses employing more than 17,000 people work in life sciences, health and health-tech across Vaughan.
Cortellucci Vaughan Hospital opened in 2021 as a full-service community hospital and Canada's first smart hospital.

overview: Vaughan reached 323,103 residents in the 2021 Census, a 5.5 percent rise from 306,233 in 2016, with 103,914 occupied private dwellings across 272.44 square kilometres. The city is still adding new households, particularly in its higher-density growth areas.

Its median household income of $124,000 in 2020 is the highest among the cities profiled here, and the median age is 41.6. For a local business, that combination points to established families with strong spending power who expect quality and convenience, alongside a large base of business customers in the city's industrial and office parks.

byService.lead-generation: Vaughan's 5.5 percent growth between 2016 and 2021 and its $124,000 median household income make higher-value offers viable, so lead generation can favour quality over volume.
byService.seo: Because Vaughan is made up of distinct communities such as Woodbridge, Maple, Thornhill and Kleinburg, SEO should build pages and reviews for each rather than relying on one city page.
byService.website-development: For households earning a median $124,000, a Vaughan website should feel premium, load quickly on mobile and show detailed service descriptions that justify higher prices.
byService.branding: Vaughan brands compete for affluent households and a large business community at once, so visual identity and tone should be refined enough to serve both audiences credibly.
